messages.text: BL-1842 🎵 in progress — A local-model seat's health is one command away - a report reads the seat's qwen usage and session records and the Ollama server log and prints each session's requests, compressions, errors, output and reasoning tokens, how the model is served (layers on GPU, context, KV cache type, tokens/s) and whether the seat is generating, idle or down, so a role judges a local seat from its measured turns instead of its pane
